newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CBANK 2-WK REV REPO SELLS OUT AT 25 PCT MAX.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CBANK 2-WK REV REPO SELLS OUT AT 25 PCT MAX.

text.p: Yield in a Czech National Bank (CNB) two-week reverse repo tender to drain liquidity from the market on Wednesday averaged the maximum set rate of 25 percent, the CNB said.
The central bank said it accepted all bids submitted at that level, but did not provide any details on the amount of liquidity drained.
In a similar operation last Wednesday, yield averaged the maximum rate of 29 percent.
The central bank has been holding repo tenders draining liquidity fronm the market almost daily in the past weeks in order to help the crown currency.
